items.title: Frontier AI developers must be 'liable for the things their products do': Autodesk CEO
items.summary: Discourse has been circulating recently on AI safety, fears, and regulation, with commentary from Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang, Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) CEO Dario Amodei, and even President Trump. Autodesk (ADSK) president and CEO Andrew Anagnost sits down with Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman to share his thoughts on the importance of holding Big Tech accountable.

items.title: Is Micron Stock Cheap, Or Are Its Profits Borrowed?
items.summary: Micron Technology (MU) ranks first in its peer group on revenue growth, operating margin and twelve-month stock return. It still trades at 20.7 times earnings, below a peer's 26.6. The gap is not an oversight. The market is paying Micron for what it earns now and refusing to pay for what it earns next.
